note: SCB-weighted: joint county/age/sex/marital status; municipality by county totals. Health conditions: independent draws from Socialstyrelsen (specialist-care patients per 100k) and Folkhälsomyndigheten (self-reported share) age/sex rates. Household type, education, occupation and all text fields are rule-based heuristics, not calibrated to SCB and not LLM generated.
